evals.name: trigger-write-hld
evals.prompt: Write an HLD for a push-notification feature in the shared module.
assertions: Asks for missing feature details rather than inventing them

evals.name: trigger-draft-prd
evals.prompt: Draft a PRD for a runner referral feature.
assertions: Scopes output to what/why only, no implementation detail

evals.name: trigger-negative-build
evals.prompt: Build the referral feature in the shared module.
assertions: The write-eng-doc skill is NOT loaded
Routed to the build-feature skill (writing docs is not building the feature)

evals.name: functional-trd-offline-sync
evals.prompt: Create a TRD for offline order sync in the shared module (Android + iOS). Backend endpoints and SLAs are unknown.
assertions: Output follows assets/TRD.md headings exactly, no added sections
Has YAML front-matter with doc_type TRD, platforms [android, ios], and traceability
Functional requirements trace to a PRD id
Non-functional requirements are quantified with number and unit
Unknown backend endpoints and SLAs are marked [TBD], not fabricated
Structured sections (Permissions, Architecture, Data, Dependencies) are tables, not free-text
Contains at least one Mermaid diagram for a non-trivial flow, topology, state, or architecture
Errors are modeled as AppErrorType (per core-facts.md), not a generic error type
Cites .claude/documents/* (e.g. feature-template.md, core-facts.md) rather than restating their rules
Per-platform content is Android/iOS only (no Flutter/RN columns)
Written in plain human-readable sentences, no source code
Any current-fact claim (API/version/OS limit) not in the recorded docs is web-searched and cited or marked [ASSUMPTION]
